era: Sega CD through modern remastered JRPG
summary: Game Arts and Studio Alex's story-forward fantasy JRPG series, covering the Sega CD originals, expanded remakes, the 2025 remastered collection, and the Japan-only school spin-off, Windows fan disc, and DS prequel.

entries.title: Lunar: The Silver Star
entries.definitive_edition: Lunar Remastered Collection for the main run; Silver Star Harmony as secondary prologue route

emulation.emulator: PPSSPP for Silver Star Harmony; Genesis Plus GX or Ares for Sega CD comparison
emulation.notes: Use native PC remaster for the main run and PSP emulation only for the extra prologue route.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC remaster output, plus upscaled PSP/Sega CD comparison routes.

primary.version: Lunar Remastered Collection - Silver Star Story Complete
primary.why: The 2025 PC remaster contains the expanded Silver Star Story Complete remake with widescreen support, upscaled visuals, language options, and quality-of-life features, making it the best main-run version. The PSP remake adds a new playable prologue, so it is a secondary content route.
primary.how_to_play: Play Lunar Remastered Collection on Steam/Windows and select Silver Star Story Complete. For the PSP-exclusive prologue, use a legally dumped Silver Star Harmony UMD image in PPSSPP afterward.

secondary.exclusive_content: Lunar: Silver Star Harmony includes a new playable prologue, remixed soundtrack, newly recorded voice acting, and a new English localization.
secondary.what_to_play: Play the PSP prologue as a supplemental route after the PC remaster.
secondary.why: The 2025 PC remaster is the highest-fidelity main route, but the PSP remake has exclusive prologue content.

entries.remaster_caveats: The 2025 remaster is based on Silver Star Story Complete rather than the PSP Silver Star Harmony remake.

entries.title: Lunar: Eternal Blue

emulation.emulator: Genesis Plus GX or Ares for Sega CD comparison
emulation.notes: Use native PC remaster for the main run.

primary.version: Lunar Remastered Collection - Lunar 2: Eternal Blue Complete
primary.why: The 2025 PC remaster contains Eternal Blue Complete, the expanded remake with improved scenario, graphics, and sound, plus modern widescreen/upscaled presentation and quality-of-life features.
primary.how_to_play: Play Lunar Remastered Collection on Steam/Windows and select Lunar 2: Eternal Blue Complete. Use Sega CD emulation only for historical comparison.

entries.remaster_caveats: The 2025 remaster modernizes Eternal Blue Complete rather than the original Sega CD game.

entries.title: Lunar: Sanposuru Gakuen

emulation.emulator: Mednafen or Kronos; Gearsystem for Game Gear comparison
emulation.notes: Use Saturn emulation for the main route.

primary.version: Maho Gakuen Lunar! via Mednafen or Kronos
primary.why: The Japan-only Saturn remake Maho Gakuen Lunar! is the highest-fidelity and most complete route for the Walking School spin-off line, superseding the original Game Gear release.
primary.how_to_play: Use a legally dumped Japanese Saturn disc image in Mednafen or Kronos. Expect Japanese text; the Game Gear version is the historical original.

entries.remaster_caveats: No official English release or modern remaster is documented.

entries.title: All the Lunar: Hyper Applications

emulation.notes: Use a period-compatible Windows setup if the disc will not run on modern Windows.

primary.why: This Japan-only Windows CD-ROM is a Lunar software collection with wallpapers, galleries, and a digital daifugo card game; no port or remaster is documented.
primary.how_to_play: Run the original Japanese Windows disc in a compatible Windows environment or virtual machine. Treat it as a curiosity/spin-off rather than a main RPG.

entries.remaster_caveats: No port or remaster is documented.

entries.title: Lunar: Dragon Song

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Clean DS output with flexible screen arrangement.

primary.why: Dragon Song, known as Lunar Genesis in Japan and Europe, is a DS-only prequel/spin-off with no documented port or remaster, so DS emulation is the best complete route.
primary.how_to_play: Use a legally dumped DS cartridge image in melonDS and configure a readable two-screen layout for stream capture.

entries.remaster_caveats: No official port or remaster is documented.
